commit_message:
avformat/mov: improve HEIF parsing

Parse iprp and iinf boxes and its child boxes to get the actual codec used
(AV1 for avif, HEVC for heic), and properly export extradata and other
properties in a generic way.
The avif tests reference files are updated as the extradata is now exported.

Based on a patch by Swaraj Hota

Co-authored-by: Swaraj Hota <swarajhota353@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: James Almer <jamrial@gmail.com>

fix_commit_message:
avformat/mov: don't use an allocated array for sample_size with HEIF images

The array is only ever needed for streams where each sample entry may have a
different value. Given that for non animated HEIF there's a single value that
applies to the image, use the field defined for that.

Fixes: NULL pointer dereference
Fixes: 437528618/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-ffmpeg_dem_MOV_fuzzer-6537287645331456

Found-by: continuous fuzzing process https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/tree/master/projects/ffmpeg
Signed-off-by: James Almer <jamrial@gmail.com>
agent_reasoning:
The bug-introducing commit added HEIF/AVIF parsing support that synthesizes a fake MOVStreamContext, allocating a single-element sample_sizes array to satisfy the generic mov_build_index() indexing code used by real trak atoms. This left an array-based invariant (sample_count must stay 1) that could be violated on crafted input, causing an out-of-bounds/NULL dereference per OSS-Fuzz 437528618.

I applied the equivalent of the fix commit: removed the sc->sample_sizes allocation (and its count assignment) from heif_add_stream(), and at the point where each HEIF item's properties are applied to its stream in mov_read_header(), replaced the `sc->sample_sizes[0] = item->extent_length;` write with setting the scalar `sc->sample_size`/`sc->stsz_sample_size` fields plus `sc->sample_count = 1`, matching how the fix commit changed the equivalent (later-refactored) mov_parse_heif_items function. This eliminates the array indexing entirely for this code path, removing the vulnerability class. No test files were modified, and the change is scoped to libavformat/mov.c as in the original fix.
